discrepancies.reference_text: मैं तो मुंबई में हूं अभी
discrepancies.explanation: The reference says 'I am in Mumbai right now', but the translation says 'I have toured Mumbai'.
The translation omits the highly vulgar Hindi insult 'भोसड़ी वाले' (cunts/motherfuckers), softening it to 'completely pathetic'.

discrepancies.reference_text: अरे बहुत खराब खराब है बहनचोद
discrepancies.translation_text: Oh, they are very bad, bad
discrepancies.explanation: The translation omits the strong Hindi swear word 'बहनचोद' (sisterfucker).
The translation changes 'Gandhi Maidan' (a famous ground/park) to 'Gandhi Bazaar'.
The translation incorrectly translates the name 'Priya Raj' as the city 'Prayagraj' at [06:31].
The translation completely omits the vulgar swear word 'भोसड़ी' (cunt) at the very end of the call.
